paper.title_en: Primordial black holes and induced gravitational waves from localized features in DBI inflation
paper.abstract_en: We investigate primordial black hole formation in a Dirac-Born-Infeld inflationary framework in which the background dynamics are determined by explicit functional forms of the inflaton potential $V(φ)$ and the warp factor $f(φ)$. The background equations are solved numerically to obtain the evolution of the slow-roll parameters. We show that a localized feature in the potential, accompanied by a correlated structure in the warp factor, dynamically induces a transient suppression of the slow-roll parameter, leading to a short-lived non-attractor phase. This behavior generates an enhancement of the curvature power spectrum on small scales, while preserving consistency with CMB-scale observables. The Mukhanov-Sasaki equation is then solved numerically to compute the resulting power spectrum, which exhibits narrow and localized peaks in the PBH abundance across different mass ranges. We also evaluate the associated stochastic background of induced gravitational waves and find that the predicted signal can fall within the sensitivity bands of future pulsar timing arrays and space-based interferometers, depending on the scale of the inflationary feature. A parameter scan in the $(r,n_s)$ plane shows that the large-scale predictions remain consistent with current observational constraints.

decision.title_zh: DBI暴胀中局部特征产生的原初黑洞和诱导引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了狄拉克-玻恩-因费尔德暴胀框架中的原初黑洞形成，其中背景动力学由暴胀子势V(φ)和翘曲因子f(φ)的显式函数形式决定。我们数值求解背景方程以获得慢滚参数的演化。我们表明，势中的局部特征伴随着翘曲因子中的相关结构，动态地诱导慢滚参数的瞬态抑制，导致短暂的非吸引子阶段。这种行为在小尺度上增强了曲率功率谱，同时保持与CMB尺度观测的一致性。然后数值求解Mukhanov-Sasaki方程以计算所得的功率谱，该功率谱在不同质量范围内表现出窄而局部的原初黑洞丰度峰。我们还评估了相关的诱导引力波随机背景，发现预测的信号可能落入未来脉冲星计时阵列和天基干涉仪的灵敏度带内，具体取决于暴胀特征的大小。在(r, n_s)平面上的参数扫描表明，大尺度预测与当前观测约束保持一致。
